spans.s:
mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Clothed, accoutred, dressed.
E.
अपि, and नह to bind, aff. क्त.

m. (-सः)
1 Cough, catarrh.
2 Cold, affecting the nose, inflammation of the schneiderian membrane.
E.
पीन fat, षो to destroy, aff. क.

ind.
Having put on or dressed.
E.
अपि before, नह to tie, ल्यप् aff.

A trident or threepronged spear.
3 The trident of Ś

A shower of dust.
f. (-की)
A musical instrument, a sort of viol.
E.
पा to preserve, (the world,) Uṇādi aff. आक, the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम् augment.

m. (-की)
ŚIVA.
E.
पिनाक ŚIVA'S bow or trident, and इनि aff.

n. (-सं)
Asafœtida.
E.
अपि before न्यस (compounded of नि and अस to throw), to be given or place in condiments, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fat, bulky, corpulent, large.
E.
प्यै to grow or enlarge, aff. क्त, form irr.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Having a cold.
E.
पीनस, and इनि aff.

f. (-ध्नी)
A cow with full or large udders.
E.
पीन large, उधस् an udder, डीष् aff. and अनङ् augment.
